integrity: The prefix tree is exhaustive because both power-freeness and zero palindromic defect are prefix-hereditary in the needed direction. Two independent richness predicates reproduce the same levels through \(50\), and every boundary image is directly rechecked with exact period arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: The result classifies only the length-\(49\) equality cases for the \(\mathtt{0121012}\) row of the finite obstruction used in the binary-rich repetition-threshold structure theorem. The repetition threshold itself and the scalar cutoff \(49\) are prior work. Unpublished source-author search output could contain the same equality list.
title: Three extremizers at the length-\(49\) rich-word preimage boundary
